{{Quote|Exploring? What's to explore? It's a patch of mud spattered with permacrete habitation. I've seen more promising sites on the underside of a shoe.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] on Dathomir Spaceport|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
'''Dathomir Spaceport''' was the preeminent [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It consisted primarily of a grassy and muddy field that housed several dull gray prefabricated [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]] domes, among them an administrative building, a communications center, a hostel, several small [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], and [[Monarg's Mechanic Works]]. It was surrounded by a mesh [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] fence, and was due west of marshlands. [[Tarth Vames]] was the deputy director of operations in [[43 ABY]], when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]] [[Skywalker family/Legends|Skywalker]] brought the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'' to Dathomir in pursuit of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]].
